blocks.html:
Full Car Wrap

Does your car need a spruce-up or a colour change? Subtle changes like a matte finish or a different shade of colour could be enough. Car enthusiasts, tend to customize the engine or the mechanics of the vehicle. Few people go the distance and change the entire vehicle’s colour either via a paint job or vinyl wrap. A good customer of ours dropped off his, personal vehicle, a Mercedes C63 AMG 2-door version for a full car wrap. This is the third Mercedes AMG Vinyl Wrap Toronto has done in the last month. Each of the Mercedes AMGs has been slightly different, and the customer’s requests have all been different. This full wrap was completed in matte metallic charcoal vinyl. The customer decided that the matte vinyl and the chrome delete would ensure the car was noticeable. The client wanted a full wrap including the bumpers but not the roof. Pictures below show the installation process, including the removal of the bumpers to wrap them separately. Removing the bumpers from the vehicle is the best way and least hassle our installation team has found to wrap bumpers. Our experienced installers remove certain parts of the vehicle to ensure a better wrap. This can include, door handles, antennas, badges, and spoilers to mention a few. Have you heard of knifeless tape, it’s almost a staple when wrapping a vehicle. The use means we do not cut on the paint of your pride and joy.
Vinyl Wrap Toronto does not do too many full car wraps in matte metallic charcoal. Most drivers choose either matte black or glossy black for a full car wrap. The chrome trim was wrapped in glossy black as per the customer to complete the transformation. This Mercedes C63 AMG has really changed thanks to the full wrap.
